_note: Once a week the robot searches YouTube for real Thai tutorial videos for every lesson of the 'human video' and 'AI video' chapters. One lesson = 1 search (q). A video is kept only when its title has a teaching word (สอน / วิธี / how to ...) AND at least one word of EVERY group in 'must' AND none of 'not', it is 45 s to 30 min long, and its owner allows embedding. Results stay in YouTube's relevance order (NOT sorted by views: that picked popular off-topic clips). 'pinned' = video ids chosen by hand, always shown first while they still exist. best_ai = the most viewed AI-made videos to learn from.
